{{Quote|We are a simple people. We trust easily, and we were betrayed.|[[Tryla/Legends|Tryla]]|<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>}}
The '''Ming Po''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]].

==Biology and appearance==
Ming Po shared many physical traits with baseline [[Human/Legends|Humans]], sharing the same facial structure and features, as well as having two legs, and two arms with five-fingered hands. They were shorter than their human counterparts however.

==Society and culture==
The Ming Po were a peaceful and easily trusting people. They lived in simple villages on their snow-covered [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Despite this, there was at least one [[Unidentified Ming Po animal trainer|unidentified Ming Po]] who left the planet for a much more different life, working for the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]], overseeing the would-be attempted execution of [[Julia/Legends|Queen Julia]] of [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]] before their plans were thwarted by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Jedi Master, Mace Windu]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and his marauding [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] soldiers chose Carlac as their base of operations. They set up a rudimentary tent camp near a [[Ming Po town]] overseen by [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Pieter/Legends|Pieter]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] raided the town for supplies, subjugated the townspeople and kidnapped the women of the town, including the chieftain's granddaughter, [[Tryla/Legends|Tryla]], to be servants in their camp.

After the arrival of [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to deliver a [[Holotrace device/Legends|transmission chip]] to the Death Watch in order to kill [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Pieter arrived in the Death Watch's camp to voice his complaints with their dealings prior and demanded them to release their women the following morning. After Pre Vizsla agreed to these terms, Pieter left. Death Watch honored their deal and came to the town to release the Ming Po women, only for Pre Vizsla to immediately kill the women and order for his men to destroy the town and proceeded to burn it to the ground, saying 'Welcome to Death Watch' to Lux Bonteri as it happened. The assault on the town was cut-short by Ahsoka who revealed herself to Death Watch as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

Despite Ahsoka's intervention, after her and Lux Bonteri's escape from the planet, the Ming Po were harassed by Death Watch later on. When the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] and a unnamed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] arrived on Carlac to deal with the remaining battle-droids from a shot down munificent frigate from an earlier battle, Death Watch threatened the lives of a handful of Ming Po people if they did not leave the planet. It wouldn't be until after [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla's]] defeat at the hands of the Jedi Knight and consequently retreat that the Ming Po would be finally be left alone from Death Watch and the Clone Wars. There were at least two villages burnt down by Death Watch.
